dispositions.question: Does the reducer duration path ignore death because npc_is_present delegates to a duration helper?
dispositions.result: Rejected for the traced path: patient_presence_suppression_at calls character_alive_at and sets health_suppressed when false; DailyPresenceWindow::remaining_minutes rejects suppressed presence. A dead or not-yet-born character with valid life records is therefore not accepted by this path. Other presence consumers remain independently open.

dispositions.question: Do the reducer and view agree if the birth record is missing?
dispositions.result: Open conditional policy/state question. The reducer character_alive_at requires a birth row, whereas patient_presence_suppression_at_view treats an absent birth row as satisfying its birth-time check. If a character exists, has no birth or death row, no active patient suppression, a valid in-window presence and otherwise satisfies the investigation projection, the view can report available while the traced LocateContact reducer rejects the same presence. The ordinary insert_character_with_origin path records birth. Missing-birth supported reachability, every constructor/deletion path, intended fail-closed policy and full projection filters remain unproved; no user-facing failure or product result is asserted.
